title: Ryan Thinks He's a Millionaire in Japan
description: Ryan changes $1,000 at a Tokyo airport and thinks he's a millionaire. Maya walks him through why the yen is so cheap, why Japan spent a record ¥27 trillion defending it, and who pays the price for his ramen discount.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Hi! Hello. Konnichiwa! I'd like to change one thousand dollars, please.
lines.act: the young man on the left slides a few dollar bills across the counter, beaming
lines.react: the clerk in the navy uniform on the right smiles politely, mouth closed

lines.speaker: exchange_clerk
lines.text: Of course. After our fee... that's one hundred and fifty-six thousand yen.
lines.act: the clerk in the navy uniform on the right counts a thick stack of banknotes and pushes it toward him
lines.react: the young man on the left stares at the stack, his smile slowly freezing, eyes widening, mouth closed

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: ...How many thousand?

lines.speaker: exchange_clerk
lines.text: One hundred and fifty-six thousand, sir.

scenes.narration: Hi! Hello. Konnichiwa! I'd like to change one thousand dollars, please. Of course. After our fee... that's one hundred and fifty-six thousand yen. ...How many thousand? One hundred and fifty-six thousand, sir.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Maya. Maya! Are you sitting down?
lines.act: the young man on the left rushes to the woman, clutching a thick stack of banknotes

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm standing, Ryan. We're in an airport.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: I'm a millionaire.
lines.react: the woman on the right just looks at him, one eyebrow slowly rising, mouth closed

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You're a hundred-and-fifty-six-thousand-aire.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Okay, but that's so close.

scenes.narration: Maya. Maya! Are you sitting down? I'm standing, Ryan. We're in an airport. I'm a millionaire. You're a hundred-and-fifty-six-thousand-aire. Okay, but that's so close.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You order at the machine. Pick a button, pay, and give the ticket to the chef.
lines.act: the woman on the right points toward the side, explaining patiently

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Which one's the most expensive?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Why is that your first question?

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Because I'm rich now, Maya. The special. Fifteen hundred yen. Three of them.
lines.act: the young man on the left proudly presses a button three times with one finger

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Three?

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: One for you, one for me... and one for confidence.
lines.react: the woman on the right closes her eyes for a moment, holding back a smile, mouth closed

scenes.narration: You order at the machine. Pick a button, pay, and give the ticket to the chef. Which one's the most expensive? Why is that your first question? Because I'm rich now, Maya. The special. Fifteen hundred yen. Three of them. Three? One for you, one for me... and one for confidence.

lines.speaker: ramen_chef
lines.text: Three specials. Enjoy.
lines.act: the chef in the white headband on the right sets steaming bowls on the counter and smiles

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Thank you so much. This is for you.
lines.act: the young man on the left slides a few coins across the counter toward the chef

lines.speaker: ramen_chef
lines.text: Ah, no, no. Thank you, but no.
lines.act: the chef on the right gently slides the coins back with a polite little bow

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: No, please. I insist.
lines.act: the young man on the left slides the coins back again, smiling

lines.speaker: ramen_chef
lines.text: Really. It's okay.
lines.act: the chef on the right slides the coins back once more, still smiling, and bows
lines.react: the young man on the left freezes, confused, mouth closed

scenes.narration: Three specials. Enjoy. Thank you so much. This is for you. Ah, no, no. Thank you, but no. No, please. I insist. Really. It's okay.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Maya, he won't take my money.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You don't tip in Japan. Good service is just... the service. He's not being modest, Ryan. He's being polite.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: So I just insulted a man... with coins.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Very politely, though.

scenes.narration: Maya, he won't take my money. You don't tip in Japan. Good service is just... the service. He's not being modest, Ryan. He's being polite. So I just insulted a man... with coins. Very politely, though.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: So Japan is on sale.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: For you.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: For me. Specifically.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: For anyone holding dollars. And a lot of people noticed.
